tools.name: create_music
tools.description: Submit a music production request to AImeistrO. Runs the autonomous Value Loop (bidding, MIDI generation, QC) and returns job status, selected providers, economics, provenance, and artifact reference.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve the status and result of an AImeistrO job by its job ID.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Retrieve the raw MIDI artifact for a completed AImeistrO job. Returns base64-encoded MIDI data with metadata.
